Hector V.: Heads-up: ran atlas-lite-13b (fp16) vs atlas-lite-13b-int8 on our mixed-chat slice. Quick findings and a proposed rollout.
Lina Z.: drop the numbers pls.
Hector V.: slice=mixed-chat-2k (avg 620 tokens). fp16 Rouge-L 36.7 / BERTScore 0.876. int8 Rouge-L 34.4 / BERTScore 0.865. p95 latency fp16=540ms int8=360ms. throughput +1.8x. cost/1k tokens fp16=$0.054, int8=$0.033.
M. Chen: hallucination/failure breakdown? any specific intents?
Hector V.: auto-eval (n=800): int8 mean Rouge-L drop 2.3 pts (sd 1.1). Hallucination flagged 12/800 (1.5%) vs fp16 3/800 (0.375%). Failures concentrated in "summary+fact-extract" and long multi-step instructions (>900 tokens). Most are omissions, some incorrect referents.
Lina Z.: Product note: we can accept small drops for discovery/ideation but not for fact-extract or compliance-related answers.
Hector V.: Econ quickcalc: site tokens/month ~220M. If we route 25% traffic to int8 raw infra savings ~ $9.9k/mo. Estimated cost from extra support/escalations ~$3.9k/mo -> net ~$6.0k/mo. If we also add a lightweight confidence reroute (logit threshold + intent blacklist) savings drop to $6.7k/mo net.
M. Chen: what's the classifier precision needed to be comfortable?
Lina Z.: For compliance/fact-extract we want <0.5% hallucination. That means we must keep those intents on fp16 or get near-perfect detection.
Hector V.: Proposed routing proto for canary:
```yaml
route: mixed-chat
rules:
  - if intent in [fact_extract, compliance_query, billing] then model: atlas-lite-13b-fp16
  - elif model_confidence < 0.6 then model: atlas-lite-13b-fp16
  - elif thread_tokens > 900 then model: atlas-lite-13b-fp16
  - else model: atlas-lite-13b-int8
fallback: atlas-lite-13b-fp16
metrics: rouge_l, bertscore, hallucination_rate_by_intent, cost_delta
```
ops-bot: Auto-eval snapshot: sample=200 live queries -> int8 rouge_l drop mean=2.1 (sd 0.95). hallucination flagged 4/200; manual triage confirmed 3/200 (1.5%).
Hector V.: Canary plan: 72h 5% non-sensitive traffic -> if stable, ramp to 25% over 10 days with 2% fp16 holdback for drift detection. Daily auto-eval + per-intent alerts. Rollback triggers: hallucination_rate > 1% for any sensitive intent over 6h OR rouge_l drop > 2.5 pts sustained 12h.
M. Chen: I'll prototype an edge logit-based classifier and a tiny rule for thread_tokens > 900. ETA 48h. I'll log false negatives to a new metric.
Lina Z.: QA: we'll run a focused human review on 300 policy/fact-extract samples during the ramp. Need compliance signoff before widening beyond 25% for any sensitive intent.
Hector V.: I'll publish a GTN note + cost sheet + reproducible eval notebook. Link after canary starts.
Lina Z.: Sounds good. Please include per-intent $ impact for finance and a small checklist for compliance.
Hector V.: Will do. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
